one_line: AI safety tools debut, Anthropic’s costs rise, Google faces Gemini policy pressure, and AI firms secure billions.

themes.title: New tools verify AI safety
themes.text: Anthropic released FlashProve, an open‑source system that generates cryptographic proofs that a language‑model reply came from a specific set of weights. Researchers also introduced PEARL, a reinforcement‑learning method that suppresses misaligned behaviors and remains effective after further fine‑tuning.

stories.headline: Anthropic releases FlashProve to cryptographically verify AI model responses
New PEARL method durably suppresses misaligned behaviors in language models

themes.title: Anthropic’s costs and staff changes
themes.text: Anthropic’s compute spending rose to $10 billion, representing 58 % of its Q3 revenue and widening its operating loss. In the same period, product leaders Cat Wu and Thariq Shihipar left the company’s Claude Code team.

stories.headline: Anthropic compute costs rise to 58% of revenue in Q3, widening operating loss
Cat Wu and Thariq Shihipar leave Anthropic product team for Claude Code

themes.title: Google policy pressures on Gemini
themes.text: An EU court adviser warned that Google’s Gemini chatbot may infringe press copyrights when reproducing articles. Google also announced that schools blocking Gemini will lose Search access, while later allowing administrators to enable Gemini, NotebookLM, and Search separately.

stories.headline: EU court adviser says Google’s Gemini may infringe press copyright
Google disables Search for schools that reject its AI tools
Google lets schools enable Gemini, NotebookLM and Search separately after backlash

themes.title: AI firms secure major funding
themes.text: Meta announced a cross‑border bond offering that could raise at least $20 billion for AI and data‑center expansion. AI inference startup Fal was valued at $16 billion after a $1.3 billion round, Traversal raised $120 million at a $1 billion valuation, and CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Fiddler AI for $400 million and Dreadnode for $95 million.

stories.headline: Meta targets at least $20 billion in cross‑border bond offering, debuting euro tranche
AI inference startup Fal valued at $16B after $1.3B funding round
Traversal raises $120 million at $1 billion valuation to expand AI‑driven site reliability engineering
CrowdStrike to acquire Fiddler AI for $400 million and Dreadnode for $95 million
